iteration-3 called the AMD-OLMo SFT->DPO stage a behavioural NO-OP.
claims.note: iter-4's classification rule reclassifies this pair AMBIGUOUS (reclassified=True): the dHC point estimate is a near-zero no-op, but its 95% CI [-0.156,0.111] fails the rule's CI-width leg, so the FORMAL class is AMBIGUOUS, not NOOP, even though it is informally 'no-op-like'.
